commands.step: npm audit (advisory — does not fail the build)
commands.text:
echo '### npm audit (advisory)' >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
echo '```' >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
npm audit --audit-level=moderate 2>&1 | tee -a "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
echo '```' >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

if [ "${GITHUB_REF_TYPE}" = "tag" ]; then
  VERSION="${GITHUB_REF_NAME#v}"
else
  VERSION=$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")
fi
echo "version=${VERSION}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
echo "Resolved version: ${VERSION}"

commands.step: Install npm >=11.5 in sandbox for OIDC trusted publishing
commands.text:
SANDBOX="$HOME/.npm-cli-sandbox"
mkdir -p "$SANDBOX"
pushd "$SANDBOX" >/dev/null
echo '{"name":"npm-cli-sandbox","version":"0.0.0","private":true}' > package.json
npm install --no-save --no-audit --no-fund --silent npm@latest
popd >/dev/null
echo "$SANDBOX/node_modules/.bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
"$SANDBOX/node_modules/.bin/npm" --version

commands.step: Guard — package.json version equals tag version
commands.text:
PKG=$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")
TAG_VERSION="${{ steps.bump.outputs.version }}"
if [ "$PKG" != "$TAG_VERSION" ]; then
  echo "::error::package.json version ($PKG) does not match tag version ($TAG_VERSION) — refusing to publish a divergent release." >&2
  exit 1
fi
echo "Version guard passed: package.json and tag both at $PKG"

commands.step: Publish to npm with provenance (OIDC Trusted Publisher)

commands.text:
TAG="v${{ steps.bump.outputs.version }}"
VERSION="${{ steps.bump.outputs.version }}"
if gh release view "$TAG" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "Release $TAG already exists; skipping create."
else
  # Extract the CHANGELOG section for this version: everything
  # between `## [<version>]` and the next `## [` heading.
  NOTES_FILE="$(mktemp)"
  awk -v ver="$VERSION" '
    $0 ~ "^## \\[" ver "\\]" { capture = 1; next }
    capture && /^## \[/ { exit }
    capture { print }
  ' CHANGELOG.md > "$NOTES_FILE"
  if [ -s "$NOTES_FILE" ]; then
    echo "Using CHANGELOG section for $VERSION as release notes."
    gh release create "$TAG" --title "$TAG" --notes-file "$NOTES_FILE"
  else
    echo "No CHANGELOG section for $VERSION; using auto-generated notes."
    gh release create "$TAG" --title "$TAG" --generate-notes
  fi
fi
